assets.modifications: Only the 2026 Lerno–Sa Conchedda–Monti di Alà special-stage path retained from the organiser’s individual SS8/11 map. 2,048 original segments simplified to 152 with maximum 0.55 PDF-unit deviation, rotated 18 degrees and uniformly scaled. Transparent exterior and enclosed regions; white 4-unit stroke. Start circle and chequered finish added at the source-verified endpoints. Transfers, satellite imagery, labels and logos removed. This is one prominent stage, not an edition overview.
